<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>TAB.com.au</title>
    <style>
        body {
            font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            font-weight: 300;
            overflow: hidden
        }

        p {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.75
        }

        a {
            color: #c1d22a
        }

        .phone-link::before {
            content: '';
            vertical-align: text-bottom;
            display: inline-block;
            margin-right: 5px;
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            background-repeat: no-repeat;
            background-image: url(data:image/png;base64,)
        }

        * {
            box-sizing: border-box
        }

        body {
            margin: 0;
            font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.42857143;
            color: #333;
            background-color: #fff
        }

        a {
            text-decoration: none
        }

        a:focus,
        a:hover {
            text-decoration: underline
        }

        header {
            width: 100%;
            height: 58px;
            background: #008542;
            position: relative
        }

        .container {
            color: #fff;
            max-width: 700px;
            width: 90%;
            padding: 25px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
            text-align: center;
            margin: 30px auto 0
        }

        .container h1,
        .container p {
            text-align: left
        }

        .container h1 {
            font-size: 25pt;
            line-height: 25pt;
            color: #c1d22a
        }

        .container p {
            line-height: 15pt
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <header><svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 86 44" version="1.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
            style="fill-rule:evenodd;clip-rule:evenodd;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-miterlimit:1.41421">
            <g transform="matrix(0.51497,0,0,0.517647,0,0)">
                <use xlink:href="#_Image1" x="0" y="0" width="167px" height="85px" />
            </g>
        </svg></header>
    <main>
        <div class="container">
            <h1>tab.com.au is unavailable from your location</h1>
            <p>It appears you are visiting our website from a country we are unable to give access to.<br><br>If you are
                in a country we are licensed to operate in, get in touch and we will do all we can to connect
                you.<br>That is something you can bet on.<br><br><span style="line-height:24pt"><a class="phone-link"
                        href="tel:131-802">131 802</a> (In Australia)<br><a class="phone-link"
                        href="tel:+61-2-9407-0850">+61 2 9407 0850</a> (International Betting)<br><a class="phone-link"
                        href="tel:+61-2-8863-5320">+61 2 8863 5320</a> (International Customer Service)<br>Contact <a
                        href="https://help.tab.com.au/s/contactsupport">Help Desk</a></span></p>
        </div>
    </main>
</body>

</html>
